Blocking (code review): pi-provider-kimi-code@0.6.13 is a hardcoded constant in packages/runtime/src/pi/provider.ts; scripts/dependency-pins.ts and scripts/update-dependencies.ts have no pin kind for Pi packages, so mise run deps:update and deps:check never see it, while docs/pi/README.md:19 and docs/pi/installation.md:43-44 and AGENTS.md say every reused extension is pinned and moves only through deps:update.
